cases.name: every skill with context: fork names the agent it runs in, a charter of its own pack (D57) - ws-check, ws-docs, ws-image, ws-migrate in ws-runner; contrib-validate in contrib-validator; quality-report in quality-runner - and docs-audit alone keeps the default general-purpose
cases.cmd: P={{CLAUDE}}/../packs; [ -d "$P" ] || { printf 'ok (skipped: no packs/ beside claude/ - a deployed harness)'; exit 0; }; fm() { awk 'NR==1 && $0!="---" {exit} NR>1 && $0=="---" {exit} NR>1' "$1"; }; n=0; for f in $(find "$P" {{CLAUDE}}/skills -name SKILL.md | LC_ALL=C sort); do fm "$f" | grep -qx 'context: fork' || continue; n=$((n+1)); s=$(basename "$(dirname "$f")"); a=$(fm "$f" | sed -n 's/^agent: //p'); pack=${f#$P/}; pack=${pack%%/*}; case "$s" in ws-check|ws-docs|ws-image|ws-migrate) want=ws-runner ;; contrib-validate) want=contrib-validator ;; quality-report) want=quality-runner ;; docs-audit) want= ;; *) printf 'BAD-unexpected-fork:%s ' "$s"; continue ;; esac; [ "$a" = "$want" ] || printf 'BAD-agent:%s=%s ' "$s" "$a"; [ -z "$a" ] || [ -f "$P/$pack/claude/agents/$a.md" ] || printf 'BAD-charter-missing:%s ' "$a"; fm "$f" | grep -qx 'disable-model-invocation: true' || printf 'BAD-invocable:%s ' "$s"; done; printf 'forked=%s' "$n"

cases.name: the three runner charters exist with name, a one-line plain description, tools, model, maxTurns and effort, disallow Agent (no nesting), and ws-runner is read-only (neither Write nor Edit, both disallowed) where contrib-validator and quality-runner write
cases.cmd: P={{CLAUDE}}/../packs; [ -d "$P" ] || { printf 'ok (skipped: no packs/ beside claude/ - a deployed harness)'; exit 0; }; fm() { awk 'NR==1 && $0!="---" {exit} NR>1 && $0=="---" {exit} NR>1' "$1"; }; desc_ok() { d=$(fm "$1" | sed -n 's/^description: //p'); [ "$(fm "$1" | grep -c '^description:')" = 1 ] && [ -n "$d" ] && case "$d" in '"'*|"'"*|*': '*|*' #'*) false ;; *) true ;; esac; }; for pa in repo-orkeon-workshop:ws-runner contrib:contrib-validator quality:quality-runner; do p=${pa%%:*}; a=${pa#*:}; f="$P/$p/claude/agents/$a.md"; [ -f "$f" ] || { printf 'BAD-missing:%s ' "$a"; continue; }; fm "$f" | grep -qx "name: $a" || printf 'BAD-name:%s ' "$a"; desc_ok "$f" || printf 'BAD-description:%s ' "$a"; for k in tools model maxTurns effort; do fm "$f" | grep -qE "^$k: [^ ]" || printf 'BAD-%s:%s ' "$k" "$a"; done; fm "$f" | sed -n 's/^disallowedTools: //p' | grep -qw Agent || printf 'BAD-nests:%s ' "$a"; t=$(fm "$f" | sed -n 's/^tools: //p'); d=$(fm "$f" | sed -n 's/^disallowedTools: //p'); if [ "$a" = ws-runner ]; then printf '%s' "$t" | grep -qwE 'Write|Edit' && printf 'BAD-ws-runner-writes '; printf '%s' "$d" | grep -qw Write && printf '%s' "$d" | grep -qw Edit || printf 'BAD-ws-runner-not-disallowed '; else printf '%s' "$t" | grep -qw Write && printf '%s' "$t" | grep -qw Edit || printf 'BAD-%s-cannot-write ' "$a"; fi; done; printf 'ok'

cases.name: each forked skill says in its first body paragraph that it runs in a forked subagent and names its agent; none of the six delegates to a subagent any more (its own context is the throw-away one)
cases.cmd: P={{CLAUDE}}/../packs; [ -d "$P" ] || { printf 'ok (skipped: no packs/ beside claude/ - a deployed harness)'; exit 0; }; fm() { awk 'NR==1 && $0!="---" {exit} NR>1 && $0=="---" {exit} NR>1' "$1"; }; for sf in repo-orkeon-workshop/ws-check repo-orkeon-workshop/ws-docs repo-orkeon-workshop/ws-image repo-orkeon-workshop/ws-migrate contrib/contrib-validate quality/quality-report; do f="$P/${sf%%/*}/claude/skills/${sf#*/}/SKILL.md"; a=$(fm "$f" | sed -n 's/^agent: //p'); body=$(awk 'n>=2; /^---$/ {n++}' "$f"); first=$(printf '%s\n' "$body" | awk 'BEGIN{RS=""} /^# /{next} {print; exit}'); printf '%s' "$first" | grep -q 'forked subagent' && printf '%s' "$first" | grep -qF "\`$a\`" || printf 'BAD-intro:%s ' "${sf#*/}"; printf '%s' "$body" | grep -qiE 'general-purpose subagent|in a subagent|to a subagent|own subagent' && printf 'BAD-still-delegates:%s ' "${sf#*/}"; done; printf 'ok'

cases.name: the memory agents (D58): team-reviewer, dev-auditor and adversarial-reviewer carry memory: project and a Memory section that names their folder and the memory-scope hook; no other shipped charter carries a memory
cases.cmd: P={{CLAUDE}}/../packs; [ -d "$P" ] || { printf 'ok (skipped: no packs/ beside claude/ - a deployed harness)'; exit 0; }; fm() { awk 'NR==1 && $0!="---" {exit} NR>1 && $0=="---" {exit} NR>1' "$1"; }; n=0; for f in {{CLAUDE}}/agents/*.md $(find "$P" -path '*/claude/agents/*.md'); do a=$(basename "$f" .md); if fm "$f" | grep -qx 'memory: project'; then n=$((n+1)); case "$a" in team-reviewer|dev-auditor|adversarial-reviewer) ;; *) printf 'BAD-unexpected-memory:%s ' "$a" ;; esac; grep -q '^## Memory$' "$f" && grep -qF ".claude/agent-memory/$a/" "$f" && grep -qF 'memory-scope' "$f" || printf 'BAD-section:%s ' "$a"; elif fm "$f" | grep -q '^memory:'; then printf 'BAD-other-scope:%s ' "$a"; fi; done; printf 'memory=%s' "$n"
